title: Response to the comment on “Clinical features and management of odontogenic keratocysts in Gorlin–Goltz syndrome”
html: We thank the author for his interest and comments regarding our publication “Clinical features and management of odontogenic keratocysts in Gorlin–Goltz syndrome”1. We concur that histopathological examination can sometimes reveal the presence of multiple epithelial islands in the mucoperiosteal tissue overlying odontogenic keratocysts. However, it is not standard practice at our institution to send the mucoperiosteal tissue for histopathological examination . As a result, those tissues were not retained, and it is not possible to perform any additional analysis as suggested .
